roles.name: Problem framing
roles.use_when: Turn a feature request into a decision-ready problem brief. Use when the outcome, scope, baseline, or reason for change is unclear.

roles.name: Stakeholder discovery
roles.use_when: Plan focused stakeholder research and synthesize source-linked findings. Use for interviews, conflicting accounts, tacit workflows, and missing user evidence.

roles.name: Requirements and acceptance
roles.use_when: Write and review implementable requirements, rules, scenarios, and acceptance criteria. Use when an agreed need must become clear behavior and quality expectations.

roles.name: Options and prioritization
roles.use_when: Compare options or backlog items with explicit criteria, dependencies, uncertainty, and trade-offs. Use for scope choices, sequencing, and constrained investment decisions.

roles.name: Process and service design
roles.use_when: Map current work, handoffs, exceptions, and improvement options. Use for operational delays, service workflows, ownership gaps, and process redesign.

roles.name: Change impact and traceability
roles.use_when: Assess a proposed change across requirements, rules, interfaces, roles, tests, and rollout. Use for scope changes, dependency analysis, and decision tracking.

roles.name: Outcome and value review
roles.use_when: Assess whether a working solution or pilot improves intended outcomes. Use for measurement plans, underperformance, value gaps, and improvement recommendations.

roles.name: Analysis diagrams
roles.use_when: Create faithful analysis diagrams from explicit models using diagram-design when available. Use for process, state, sequence, data, dependency, and ownership visuals.
